introduction.title: Transform nested JSON with a dedicated expression language
paragraphs: JSONata is a language for selecting, filtering, aggregating, and reshaping JSON. The extension evaluates a JSONata expression against a JSON value in DuckDB and returns the transformed document.

It is useful when you need to traverse nested arrays or build a new object from several parts of a document. DuckDB’s built-in JSON operators already cover simple field extraction; JSONata gives you another way to express more involved transformations or reuse existing JSONata rules.
